routes.title: NUB Portal — Free Online Developer Tools
routes.description: A fast, private toolbox for developers: JSON formatter, diff checker, JWT decoder, Base64 encoder, YAML/CSV/Excel converters and C# POCO generators. Everything runs in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

routes.title: JSON Formatter & Validator
routes.description: Format, validate and minify JSON in your browser. Pretty-print as you type, sort keys, inspect structure in a tree view and extract fields — with instant error messages and no upload.

routes.title: Text & Code Diff Checker
routes.description: Compare two texts or code files side-by-side or inline. Syntax-aware highlighting for JSON, XML, YAML, SQL, C#, JavaScript and TypeScript, with whitespace-insensitive matching and diff navigation.

routes.title: JWT Decoder
routes.description: Decode JSON Web Token header and payload instantly. Inspect claims, issued-at and expiry times entirely offline — your token never leaves the browser.

routes.title: JSON Escape
routes.description: Escape text into a valid JSON string literal. Handles quotes, backslashes, newlines, tabs and Unicode so the result can be embedded safely in JSON.

routes.title: JSON Unescape
routes.description: Turn an escaped JSON string back into readable text. Resolves \n, \t, \", \\ and \uXXXX sequences in one step.

routes.title: Unquote JSON
routes.description: Strip the surrounding quotes and escaping from a stringified JSON payload to get the raw JSON object back — useful for logs and API traces.

routes.title: Markdown Preview
routes.description: Write Markdown and see it rendered live, with syntax-highlighted code blocks, Mermaid diagrams, image lightbox and synchronised scrolling.

routes.title: Letter & Word Counter
routes.description: Count characters, words, sentences and paragraphs in real time. Includes reading time, character frequency analysis and keyword density.

routes.title: JSON to YAML Converter
routes.description: Convert JSON into clean, readable YAML with validation as you type. Handles nested objects, arrays and multi-line strings.

routes.title: YAML to JSON Converter
routes.description: Convert YAML into formatted JSON with syntax validation. Supports anchors, multi-document files and comments.

routes.title: JSON to CSV Converter
routes.description: Turn a JSON array into CSV with a configurable delimiter and optional header row. Nested values are serialised and quoting follows RFC 4180.

routes.title: CSV to JSON Converter
routes.description: Convert CSV or TSV into a structured JSON array. Handles quoted fields, embedded delimiters and newlines, with automatic type detection.

routes.title: JSON to Excel (XLSX) Converter
routes.description: Export JSON data to a downloadable Excel .xlsx workbook. Nested objects are flattened into columns automatically — conversion happens locally.

routes.title: Excel to JSON Converter
routes.description: Convert an .xlsx or .xls spreadsheet — or pasted table data — into JSON. Drag and drop a file; parsing runs entirely in your browser.

routes.title: Base64 & URL Encoder / Decoder
routes.description: Encode and decode Base64 and URL-encoded text in both directions, with full Unicode support and instant results.

routes.title: JSON to C# POCO Generator
routes.description: Generate C# class definitions from a JSON sample. Infers types, handles nested objects and arrays, and can emit [JsonPropertyName] attributes.

routes.title: SQL Table to C# POCO Generator
routes.description: Paste a CREATE TABLE statement and get a matching C# POCO class. Maps SQL column types to CLR types and preserves nullability.

routes.title: C# ProtoMember Reindex
routes.description: Re-sequence [ProtoMember(n)] attributes across C# properties so protobuf-net tags stay contiguous after edits.

routes.title: C# Remove ProtoMember
routes.description: Strip every [ProtoMember] attribute from a C# class in one pass, leaving the rest of the code untouched.
